claims.claim: Sellected collection of books on marketing and sales
claims.evidence: Witness only reported a stack of paperback books with spines facing up; no titles/authors are readable in the report.

risks.risk: Cannot confirm the exact titles/authors or whether they are actually marketing/sales books (spines/titles not shown/readable).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the spines with titles/authors fully readable (one wide shot of the whole stack and one close-up per spine).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unverified mixed paperback book bundle (worst-case: generic/unknown titles).

risks.risk: Unknown completeness (only a portion of the full set is visible; number of books not confirmed).
risks.proof: A photo showing the full set count laid out end-to-end with the total number visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a partial/uncertain bundle (worst-case: fewer books than expected).

risks.risk: Condition uncertainty (cover/spine wear, page stains/tears, missing pages not assessed).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: front cover, spine, back cover, and an open page showing any stains/tears; plus a photo of the page edges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear and potential defects (worst-case: damaged/marked pages).

risks.risk: Edition/collectibility not confirmed (first editions/limited editions/special printings could change value).
risks.proof: Photos of the copyright page (publisher/year/edition) and any ISBN/edition markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard used paperbacks (worst-case: no special/collectible edition).

risks.risk: Accessories/bundle packaging not confirmed (could be missing).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included in the bundle laid out together (packaging, bookmarks, CDs, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Priced without any extras (worst-case: books only).

proof_requests: Send a clear wide photo showing the entire stack with all spines visible and readable.
Send close-up photos of each spine/title (or at least enough to confirm the full list).
Send photos of the front cover, back cover, spine condition, and page edges.
Send an open-page photo showing typical page condition (no missing pages/tears/stains).
Send the copyright/ISBN page for at least one book to confirm edition/year.
response.reason: The witness confirms only that it is a stack of paperback books; the report does not show readable titles/condition or the full set count. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
